turns.content: Yaar meri shaadi mein six weeks bache hain. Rohan ko haldi mein hona hai, toast bhi dena hai — first year college se mera bhai hai. Par jab bhi Bangalore se travel ki baat karta hoon, bas "dekhte hain yaar, pakka try karunga." Main khud hi uski flight book kar doon kya, khatam jhanjhat?

Yaar, **bina uski clear haan ke flight book mat karna**—warna paise bhi atak sakte hain aur awkwardness bhi badhegi. Uska “pakka try karunga” shayad budget, leave, ya koi personal uncertainty ho.

Ek baar seedha but pyaar se bol:

> “Rohan, tu mere liye genuinely important hai aur haldi + toast ke liye main tujhe count kar raha hoon. Mujhe bookings/final planning karni hai, toh please **[date] tak clear yes/no** bata de. Agar flight cost ya booking ka issue hai toh bol—main book karwa deta hoon, but pehle teri confirmed commitment chahiye.”

Agar woh haan bolta hai, tab dates/timings confirm karke book kar de. Aur deadline ke baad bhi “dekhte hain” rahe, toh toast ke liye backup rakh—dil pe mat lena, par apni shaadi ki planning uncertainty par bhi mat chhodna.

Maine check kiya, nau hazaar ki return flight hai, koi bada amount nahi. Usne do mahine pehle job switch kiya, koi startup hai. Aur aajkal uske replies bhi two-word aate hain, pehle voice notes bhejta tha. Bol raha hoon khud ko ki busy hoga, par hafton se yahi chal raha hai.

Haan, yeh sirf ₹9,000 ya flight booking ka issue nahi lag raha. **Job switch + startup + replies ka suddenly dry ho jaana**—ho sakta hai woh genuinely overwhelmed ho, leave uncertain ho, ya kisi aur cheez se struggle kar raha ho. Aur ho sakta hai woh commitment nahi de paa raha, par seedha “nahi” bolne mein awkward feel kar raha ho.

Main flight surprise mein book nahi karta. Pehle ek pressure-free call/message:

> “Bhai, wedding logistics se alag pooch raha hoon—tu theek hai? Kaafi time se tu thoda withdrawn lag raha hai. Agar work/leave/paisa ya kuch personal scene hai, bina awkward hue bol. Main chahta hoon tu aaye, flight main happily book kar dunga, but mujhe **[date] tak honest yes/no** chahiye. Nahi ho paaye toh bura nahi maanunga—bas uncertainty mein mat rakh.”

Phir usse thodi space de, lekin deadline real rakho. Agar call avoid kare ya phir “try karunga” bole, calmly kehna: **“No worries, main isse no maan ke toast ka backup arrange kar raha hoon; situation clear ho toh bata dena.”**

Aur haan—tumhara hurt hona valid hai. First-year-college wala “bhai” jab shaadi ke time emotionally unavailable lage, toh naturally chubhega. Bas abhi uski khamoshi ko rejection ka final proof mat banao; pehle ek genuine check-in kar lo.

Sach bolun toh ab bura lagne laga hai. Agar sach mein care karta toh pehle din haan bol deta na? Soch raha hoon aaj raat call karke seedha puchh loon — "bhai aa raha hai ya nahi, haan ya na." Kam se kam pata toh chalega main kahan khada hoon.

Haan yaar, call kar. Tumhe clarity maangne ka poora haq hai—bas **“agar care karta toh turant haan bolta”** ko final truth mat maan lena. Care ho sakti hai aur saath mein leave, startup pressure, burnout, ya koi personal scene bhi.

Call mein firm raho, accusatory nahi:

> “Bhai, tu mere liye important hai, isliye honestly bol raha hoon—teri uncertainty se mujhe bura lag raha hai. Mujhe aaj clarity chahiye: kya tu shaadi/haldi ke liye commit kar sakta hai? Haan ya na, dono theek hain; ‘dekhte hain’ ab workable nahi hai. Cost issue hai toh flight main book kar dunga. Bas sach bata.”

Phir chup rehkar usse jawab dene do.  
- **Haan:** exact dates aur leave confirm karwao; uske baad flight book karo.  
- **Na:** दुख होगा, लेकिन जवाब मिल जाएगा—toast किसी और को दे दो.  
- **फिर भी गोलमोल:** “ठीक है, planning ke liye main ise no maan raha hoon. Agar situation badle toh bata dena.”  

Clarity lena ultimatum nahi hai; shaadi se six weeks pehle reasonable boundary hai. Bas call ka aim uski care ko test karna nahi, **commitment clear karna** rakho.

Meri fiancée bol rahi hai main overthink kar raha hoon, woh bas busy hoga. Par yeh wahi banda hai jo 2019 mein meri behen ki shaadi ke liye overnight bus se aaya tha. Kuch toh badla hai aur samajh nahi aa raha kya, aur haldi se do hafte pehle main usse naraaz baitha hoon, yeh feeling hi ganda hai.

Yaar, tum overthink *kar bhi rahe ho sakte ho* aur tumhara gut *kuch real notice bhi kar raha ho sakta hai*—dono saath true hain. 2019 wala Rohan tumhari expectation set करता है; isliye ab ka distance sirf logistics nahi, friendship mein बदलाव जैसा लग रहा है.

Aaj ka call **attendance decision se pehle दोस्त का check-in** बनाओ:

> “Bhai, shaadi ki planning side mein rakh. Tu theek hai? Tu kuch hafton se अलग/withdrawn लग रहा है और मुझे हमारी दोस्ती को लेकर बुरा लगने लगा है. Main आरोप नहीं लगा रहा—बस समझना चाहता हूँ कि क्या चल रहा है. Agar tu nahi aa sakta, main handle kar lunga; par please mujhse honestly baat kar.”

उसकी बात पूरी सुनना—तुरंत 2019 या “अगर care करता…” मत लाना. फिर आखिर में पूछना:

> “Mujhe planning bhi lock karni hai. Kya main tujhe haldi aur toast ke लिए count karun—haan ya na?”

अगर वह खुलता है, शायद बहुत कुछ साफ हो जाए. अगर नहीं खुलता और फिर भी vague रहता है, तो gently मान लो कि वह इस समय commit नहीं कर सकता; toast का backup रखो. नाराज़ रहकर दो हफ्ते बिताने से बेहतर है एक ईमानदार बातचीत—मकसद उसे कटघरे में खड़ा करना नहीं, **रिश्ते में जो दूरी महसूस हो रही है उसे नाम देना** है.
